entries.zh: 兴兵，起兵；招募军队出征。
entries.en: to raise troops; to levy an army.

entries.zh: 搬弄是非，散布流言，挑拨离间。
entries.en: to stir up trouble by spreading talk; to raise a false report, to sow discord.
entries.notes: M 栏多出 iē̃ oā 一音节，疑原稿另含「話」字。

entries.en: to shoot a secret arrow; to strike or slander from hiding.
entries.notes: L 栏后半「lacauaculta norabedon destiene」严重讹误，释义主要依 H「暗箭」。

entries.en: to slander, to defame; to speak evil of someone.

entries.zh: 心绪，心情；搅动心绪、使人动摇。
entries.en: state of mind, mood; to stir up someone's feelings.
entries.notes: H「心緒」与 L「levantar falso」语义不完全相合，M 后半「say sim iù」残缺。

entries.zh: 嫁祸于人，把罪责推卸给别人。
entries.en: to shift the blame onto another; to frame someone.

entries.zh: 起间架，搭起房屋的框架；引申为凭空架构、捏造。
entries.en: to raise the framework of a building; hence to rig up, to fabricate.
entries.notes: H 与 L、M 对应不严，释义含推断。

entries.zh: 搅乱心绪，使人动心、心神不宁。
entries.en: to agitate someone's mind; to stir up feelings.
entries.notes: L 词头与 H 语义距离较大，释义依 H、M 对音。

entries.en: to loose a secret arrow; to strike from hiding.

entries.zh: 生话，造谣，无中生有地捏造话头。
entries.en: to fabricate gossip; to make up stories, to invent talk.
to lift, to raise; to bring forward, to propose.
to raise the flag; to hoist the colours (signal flag).
to pick up; to take up what has been found.
entries.notes: L 后半「aladlasigiente quecomien çalibanta」残讹，释义务依 H、M。

entries.en: to recruit soldiers; to raise a company.
to join together; to be continuous, connected.
entries.notes: M 栏混入西文涂写（faxea、ordinaxia），L 亦讹，仅 H「綿」可据。

entries.en: sandbank; shoal, heap of sand.
entries.notes: H 末字有「坛/坦」之疑，L「banco de arena」明指沙洲。

entries.en: to gather stones with a hoe; to bind stones with lime mortar.
entries.notes: H 末字「墋/壓」存疑，L 与 H、M 不完全对应。

entries.en: to shut the window casements; to close the window doors.
entries.notes: H 栏「貓貓」与 L「puertas de la ventana」及 M「bã bã」均不合，释义仅依 L。

entries.en: to match, to pair; to be joined in marriage.
to come together; to join, to be united (in marriage).
